text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The summer training camp to hone their skills begins.
Smart Falcon is pumped and full of spirit—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, oopsie☆
I got a little too motivated♪
choice_data_list: The "Japan Dirt Derby" is coming up, too.
The "Japan Dirt Derby" is coming up, too, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
Falco's all fired up now~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Japan Dirt Derby takes place almost
simultaneously with the start of summer camp.
The main event is right around the corner.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: A bunch of super-strong girls from Falco's generation are gathering together, huh.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll score a flashy win
and make everyone say,
'This era belongs to Falco!'☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I mean, if I'm not that strong,
maybe no one will want to cheer for me... you know?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"I think some people might be disappointed
that Falco ran in the Satsuki Sho."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I think about half the fans cheering for me right now
just love watching Falco run on dirt.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
That's why I'm gonna win the Japan Dirt Derby
and show everyone dirt-track Falco once again!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She ran the Satsuki Sho for her fans.
Her victory at the Japan Dirt Derby was for them too.
She is an Umamusume who truly cherishes her fans above all.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Once the race is over, train Falco
super hard at summer camp, okay☆!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Aha, so dependable!
Falco won't lose when it comes to momentum either!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And so, our truly, genuinely fiery summer training camp began!
